subject: Next steps: hosting selection & SOC2/BAA evidence for WellBridge POC
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire@wellbridge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>; Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-30T10:12:00Z
Subject: Next steps: hosting selection & SOC2/BAA evidence for WellBridge POC

Hi Claire –

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and a proposed path so we can converge on a hosting decision for the POC:

- Ask from WellBridge: confirm whether the POC must run in a private VPC/on-prem, or if Dedicated capacity (isolated GPUs) or Hosted API with a BAA will suffice.
- Compliance drivers you mentioned: HIPAA/BAA requirement for PHI, plus internal SOC2 checklist items (encryption at rest, audit logs retention, and incident escalation SLA).

To move fast I’ve attached a short evidence checklist (WellBridge_SOC2_Questions_v1.xlsx) and a draft BAA (BAA_draft_WellBridge.pdf). Can you please: 1) confirm the list of internal stakeholders who will review evidence, 2) share preferred timing for the security review, and 3) indicate whether your procurement team needs a completed BAA before we spin up Dedicated capacity for the demo?

Proposed next steps from our side if you’re comfortable:
- If BAA + SOC2 evidence is sufficient -> spin up a Dedicated pool for the POC (2 weeks lead time)
- If your auditors require customer-managed VPC or on-prem -> schedule an architecture review with our Private deployments team (longer lead time, ~4–6 weeks)

If easier, we can get your security contact on a short call tomorrow — copying Monica (Solutions Engineer) and Neha (Customer Security) to help triage technical evidence.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

- Reviewers: Jared (security), myself (product), and our procurement lead (TBD — I’ll loop them once we have the BAA).
- Timing: security wants initial evidence by EOD next Wednesday (2027-07-07) and will decide whether the BAA suffices or if they require a VPC.
- Procurement: likely needs an executed BAA before we move procurement budget, but security can start the evidence review in parallel.

I’ve cc’d security@wellbridge.com (this is our team alias) and Jared who will reply with specifics. If you can share a mapping of the SOC2 questions to the files you’ll provide (e.g., logs, encryption details, evidence URLs), that will speed review.

Hi Karthik / Claire —

Jared here from WellBridge security. We reviewed the attached checklist briefly and have a small set of follow-ups before we confirm whether Dedicated + BAA is acceptable for the POC:

1) Audit logs: need confirmation of retention (minimum 365 days for request/response metadata) and an export process for forensic review.
2) Encryption: clarify key management model for Dedicated host — do you support customer-managed KMS or only provider-managed keys for Dedicated? For Private VPC we expect customer KMS integration.
3) Data residency: confirm where tokens and cached prefixes are stored, and whether caching can be disabled for PHI traffic.
4) Pen tests / Vulnerability disclosures: please provide most recent pen test summary and SOC2 report redacted copy if available.

If Dedicated + an executed BAA meet the above we can proceed with Dedicated for the POC. If any of these cannot be satisfied we will need the Private deployment option (VPC/on-prem).

Suggested next step: 30-minute technical sync tomorrow at 1600 PT to walk evidence live. Can you confirm availability?

Thanks,
Jared Lim
Security Engineering Manager | WellBridge Health
jared.lim@wellbridge.com

--

Thanks Jared — appreciate the clear list. Confirming availability: Monica and Neha and I can join the 1600 PT sync tomorrow.

Quick answers up front to your bullets so the call can be focused:
- Audit logs: Redwood can retain request/response metadata for 365 days; export via secure S3 link or direct transfer. Will document retention policy in the evidences pack.
- Encryption & KMS: For Dedicated capacity we currently offer provider-managed keys (AES-256 at rest) and TLS in transit. We can integrate customer-managed KMS for Private deployments and for Dedicated in some enterprise contracts — Monica will outline options on the call.
- Caching: We can disable prefix/KV caching on a per-route basis for PHI flows; Monica will demo the flag and expected performance impact.
- Pen tests/SOC2: Attaching a redacted SOC2 summary and our current pen test engagement summary in the drive (link in related_links). If you need a fully redacted SOC2 PDF we can provide one under NDA.

Planned agenda for the 30-min sync (1600 PT):
1) Walk the SOC2 question mapping (5–10m)
2) KMS & caching architecture for Dedicated vs Private (10m)
3) Next steps for BAA execution & procurement timeline (5m)
4) Action items and owners (5m)

If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and attach the evidence pack. Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
